title: China's Biggest Ponzi Scheme Shows Rot in Internet Financing
主要内容: Bloomberg reports on a large-scale Ponzi scheme in China's internet financing sector, highlighting the risks and regulatory challenges associated with peer-to-peer lending. The article describes how Ding Ning and Zhang Min created a fraudulent scheme that transformed an industrial company into an internet phenomenon within 18 months, ultimately revealing a vast Ponzi scheme orchestrated by individuals likened to the Bernie Madoffs of China.
